audit_items.proof_trace: Reserve-level accrue_interest is called at L459 before any debt computation, and obligation-level accrue_interest is invoked inside repay_debt (obligation.move:149) before unsafe_repay_debt_only reads the debt amount — so the actual repayment amount is always computed against fully-accrued debt. The stale read at L465 (unsafe_debt_amount before obligation accrue) is used only for emode group delta tracking, not for the repayment amount, and its effect is conservative (inflates total borrow, making borrowing more restrictive).
